label: Day Scenery
description: Composite scene descriptions (place + ambience) for day and studio shots — deliberately not under location/, which models pure places.

items.name: coastal-cliff-highway
items.text: A pristine, dark asphalt coastal highway carved into a sheer, granite cliffside, with the vast, open ocean on one side and rugged, salt-sprayed rocky outcrops on the other.

items.name: winding-coastal-road
items.text: A simple, winding coastal road with the sea on one side and grassy bluffs on the other.

items.name: great-ocean-road
items.text: The Great Ocean Road in Australia, with the iconic Twelve Apostles limestone sea stacks visible from the winding, guard-railed clifftop road.

items.name: white-sand-beach
items.text: A road on a pristine white sand beach, with crystal turquoise water lapping just feet from the compacted sand path.

items.name: mirror-mountain-lake
items.text: A remote mountain lake with perfectly still, mirror-like water reflecting surrounding snowy peaks.

items.name: florida-keys-causeway
items.text: A raised causeway road connecting islands in the Florida Keys, with the shimmering, shallow turquoise water of the gulf stretching for miles on both sides.

items.name: stelvio-pass
items.text: The serpentine Stelvio Pass in the Italian Alps, an intricate ribbon of worn asphalt with dozens of tight, numbered hairpin turns stacked closely together on a steep, scree-covered mountainside.

items.name: winding-mountain-road
items.text: A generic winding mountain road with steep, rocky inclines and scattered pine trees.

items.name: black-forest-canopy
items.text: A road through the dense, dark Schwarzwald (Black Forest) in Germany, where towering fir trees create a dramatic, tunnel-like canopy over the asphalt.

items.name: gravel-rally-stage
items.text: A rough, dusty gravel rally stage winding through a dense pine forest.

items.name: autumn-foliage-road
items.text: A road covered in colorful, fallen leaves during peak autumn foliage in a deciduous forest.

items.name: wooden-ravine-bridge
items.text: A lonely, weathered wooden bridge spanning a deep, forested ravine with a clear river flowing below.

items.name: endless-prairie-highway
items.text: An endless, straight highway stretching through a vast, open prairie or grassland landscape.

items.name: financial-district
items.text: A wide, clean street in a modern financial district, surrounded by towering, contemporary skyscrapers made of reflective glass and steel.

items.name: downtown-street
items.text: A typical, clean downtown city street, flanked by a mix of modern and older office buildings.

items.name: brooklyn-brownstones
items.text: A residential street lined with classic Brooklyn brownstone buildings and iron railings.

items.name: gardens-by-the-bay
items.text: Amidst the futuristic "Supertrees" of Gardens by the Bay in Singapore, with elevated walkways visible.

items.name: brutalist-concrete
items.text: Against a backdrop of striking, monolithic brutalist concrete architecture, showing the stark geometry and textured board-formed concrete.

items.name: central-park-path
items.text: A quiet path in a meticulously landscaped urban park like Central Park, with benches and ornate lampposts.

items.name: tuscan-villa-driveway
items.text: The grand, cypress-lined gravel driveway leading to a classic Tuscan villa made of warm, weathered stone, set within a landscape of rolling hills and orderly rows of grapevines.

items.name: modern-mansion-driveway
items.text: The driveway of a large, generic modern mansion with a manicured lawn and high privacy hedges.

items.name: hollywood-hills-mansion
items.text: The perfectly manicured driveway of a modern, minimalist glass-and-steel mansion in the Hollywood Hills overlooking the sprawling Los Angeles basin.

items.name: castle-forecourt
items.text: The grand forecourt of a historic castle estate like Neuschwanstein, framed by tall stone walls and dramatic, forested alpine topography.

items.name: yacht-harbor-dock
items.text: A clean wooden dock in an exclusive yacht harbor, lined with mooring posts and coiled ropes.

items.name: salt-flat
items.text: A vast, perfectly flat salt flat like the Salar de Uyuni, with a surface of dry, hexagonal cracked salt patterns stretching to an endless, clean horizon.

items.name: airplane-hangar
items.text: The interior of a massive, empty airplane hangar with a high, curved steel-truss ceiling and a polished, sealed concrete floor.

items.name: abandoned-runway
items.text: An abandoned airport runway with cracked asphalt, faded yellow markings, and a derelict, glassless control tower.

items.name: desert-highway
items.text: A long, straight highway stretching to the horizon through an arid desert landscape.

items.name: industrial-park
items.text: An anonymous industrial park with simple, functional warehouses and loading bays.

items.name: lunar-landscape
items.text: A stark, desolate landscape of craters and fine gray dust, resembling a lunar surface.

items.name: white-infinity-cove
items.text: A clean white photography studio with a large, seamless infinity cove background.

items.name: dark-concrete-studio
items.text: A minimalist photo studio with polished, dark concrete floors and raw, unpainted concrete walls.

items.name: light-tent
items.text: Inside a large, enclosed photography light tent, providing perfectly diffused, even illumination.

items.name: dealership-showroom
items.text: Inside a bright, empty, and modern car dealership showroom with polished tile floors.

items.name: wind-tunnel
items.text: Inside a high-tech wind tunnel, with visible, non-staining streamlines of smoke flowing gracefully over the car's static body.

items.name: robotic-integration-bay
items.text: A sterile, high-tech vehicle integration bay with polished floors and poised robotic arms in the background.
